headline: Australia's Zip Plunges 50% After Fraud Incident Curtails First-Quarter Growth
summary: Shares of Australian buy-now-pay-later provider Zip plummeted 50 percent. The sharp drop followed a fraud incident that disrupted operations and dampened first-quarter financial growth.
why: Zip is a major fintech player in the buy-now-pay-later sector, operating in Australia and the United States.

impacts.name: Zip Co Ltd
impacts.why: A significant fraud incident undermined revenue growth projections and provoked an immediate sell-off.

why_moved: Zip equity halved in value after the company revealed an unexpected fraud incident that disrupted quarterly growth.
